**Van Gelder et al., 2024** refers to the 2024 edition of the European Society of Cardiology (ESC) guidelines for the management of atrial fibrillation [^src1]. This specific publication is distinguished from earlier versions of the ESC guidelines and serves as the direct evidence base for the recommendations under Indicator 8, which focuses on patient education [^src1]. 

Published in 2024, the guidelines recommend patient education as a central and integrated component of atrial fibrillation treatment [^src1]. In the context of the AFDK 2025 annual report, this publication is cited on page 84 to bridge international evidence with national clinical practices, supporting the quality development and measurement of patient education in atrial fibrillation care [^src1]. 

Because the available data is limited to a single citation context with no explicitly linked related entities or extracted claims in the database, this page reflects a sparse but precise documentation of the publication's role as the foundational evidence for Indicator 8.
